<h1 id="openplc与fractory-io联合仿真">Openplc与Fractory IO联合仿真</h1>
<h2 id="概述">概述</h2>
<ul>
<li>环境：Windows10，实现传送带自动停止</li>
<li>openplc：<a href="https://autonomylogic.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">autonomylogic.com</a>
<ul>
<li>openplc runtime（记住安装目录）：<a href="https://gh-proxy.org/https://github.com/Autonomy-Logic/openplc-runtime/releases/download/v4.2.2/OpenPLC_Runtime_4.2.2_Setup.exe" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">gh-proxy.org/https://github.com/Autonomy-Logic/openplc-runtime/releases/download/v4.2.2/OpenPLC_Runtime_4.2.2_Setup.exe</a></li>
<li>openplc editor：<a href="https://release-assets.githubusercontent.com/github-production-release-asset/724734036/ab8a70b9-c911-46d0-9011-6c9e8c4490ec?sp=r&amp;sv=2018-11-09&amp;sr=b&amp;spr=https&amp;se=2026-09-11T02%3A53%3A11Z&amp;rscd=attachment%3B+filename%3DOpenPLC.Editor_4.2.11.exe&amp;rsct=application%2Foctet-stream&amp;skoid=96c2d410-5711-43a1-aedd-ab1947aa7ab0&amp;sktid=398a6654-997b-47e9-b12b-9515b896b4de&amp;skt=2026-09-11T01%3A52%3A54Z&amp;ske=2026-09-11T02%3A53%3A11Z&amp;sks=b&amp;skv=2018-11-09&amp;sig=j5ahUAl7hIB%2BXMtwr%2FsYc44apKYf%2F6iQzmTLc4DqAUU%3D&amp;jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJnaXRodWIuY29tIiwiYXVkIjoicmVsZWFzZS1hc3NldHMuZ2l0aHVidXNlcmNvbnRlbnQuY29tIiwia2V5Ijoia2V5MSIsImV4cCI6MTc4OTA5NjQ5MywibmJmIjoxNzg5MDkyODkzLCJwYXRoIjoicmVsZWFzZWFzc2V0cHJvZHVjdGlvbi5ibG9iLmNvcmUud2luZG93cy5uZXQifQ.hJVGnAVHADYJQ7FbNFxvSBkScmfoPxJZtV1Ojqq5vZk&amp;response-content-disposition=attachment%3B%20filename%3DOpenPLC.Editor_4.2.11.exe&amp;response-content-type=application%2Foctet-stream" </ul>
</li>
<li>Fractory IO：通过网盘分享的文件：Factory IO v2.5.0 链接: <a href="https://pan.baidu.com/s/1_ERhrteaxonaf1Qj6qECeQ" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://pan.baidu.com/s/1_ERhrteaxonaf1Qj6qECeQ</a> 提取码: dt9z</li>
<li>参考教程（博图+fractory）：<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1uuiEBdEgy" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">www.bilibili.com/video/BV1uuiEBdEgy</a></li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="1789525940044" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2327530/202609/2327530-20260916140808637-2015064242.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="openplc程序编写">openplc程序编写</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>创建一个openplc梯形图项目</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>全局变量定义，Location地址可询问AI，确保点击打开Debug（亮蓝色）</p>
<ul>
<li>start：传送带启动按钮</li>
<li>stop：传送带停止按钮</li>
<li>sensor：光传感器信号</li>
<li>engine：传输带运行状态</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="1789527055894" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2327530/202609/2327530-20260916140837316-1471451430.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<ul>
<li>主程序变量
<ul>
<li>使用External引入同名全局变量，确保同名</li>
<li>由于Fractory中，停止按钮与传感器按钮默认为True，需创建两个局部变量
<ul>
<li>stop_emit：表示停止按钮处于按下状态</li>
<li>sensor_block：表示光线被遮挡</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="1789527322162" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2327530/202609/2327530-20260916140855581-917775970.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<ul>
<li>程序编写，功能如下
<ul>
<li>自锁的传送带，按一次开始按钮后持续运行（红色部分）</li>
<li>两种停止方式：按下停止按钮或者货物挡住光线（蓝色部分）</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="1789527531321" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2327530/202609/2327530-20260916140906140-1957454394.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="openplc-editor与fractory地址映射">openplc editor与Fractory地址映射</h2>
<ul>
<li>在openplc editor中创建与配置remote device，IP设置为本机网卡IP</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="1789528432024" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2327530/202609/2327530-20260916140928252-513238067.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<ul>
<li>在Fractory IO中File-Drivers中配置按钮，后续仿真连接成功时会显示绿勾，在CONFIGRATION中设置相同IP与相同端口502。</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="1789528580109" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2327530/202609/2327530-20260916140953180-451218741.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="联合仿真">联合仿真</h2>
<ul>
<li>在openplc runtime的安装目录下运行StartOpenPLC.bat或使用桌面快捷方式，会弹出命令行窗口如下图所示，打码的IP即为本机IP。</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="1789527781744" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2327530/202609/2327530-20260916143459968-985692221.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<ul>
<li>确保Fractory IO配置完毕并启动，在openplc editor中，IP设置为本机网卡IP（与remote device相同），配置device后点击Connect，首次连接会让你设置用户名与密码，请妥善保存。</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="1789529061372" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2327530/202609/2327530-20260916141031443-1926135624.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="1789528028429" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2327530/202609/2327530-20260916141044756-759418948.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<ul>
<li>随后即可编译与上传PLC程序</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="1789528212803" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2327530/202609/2327530-20260916142233820-1076782791.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<ul>
<li>点击左侧debug按钮，初始状态应当如下，如不同请重新启动所有软件并再次尝试。成功后，点击Fractory IO中的启动按钮，下方变量的值会同步更新；若正常工作，货物会被传送带运送到另一端，触碰到传感器光线后停止。</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="1789528860311" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2327530/202609/2327530-20260916142257700-1250934809.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<ul>
<li>下图展现了按下按钮后传输带的运行场景，由于梯形图程序显示存在bug导致与实际不一致，可以忽略；重点关注下方变量值变化。</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="1789529438627" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2327530/202609/2327530-20260916142316720-1870331827.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<ul>
<li>如用wireshark抓取数据包，选择回环网卡Adapter for loopback traffic capture，过滤条件为tcp.port = 502</li>
</ul>


</div>
